description: scikit-learn-compatible cross-validation for time-series and financial machine learning: purging, embargoes, combinatorial purged CV, walk-forward, and Probabilistic/Deflated Sharpe Ratio.
rules: Algorithms (purging, embargo, CPCV, PSR/DSR/MinTRL) are due to Marcos Lopez de Prado and Bailey & Lopez de Prado; this library is an open, MIT-licensed, sklearn-compatible implementation. Cite the original work, not the library, for the methods themselves.

Show real, measured numbers from examples/ and paper/ rather than inventing accuracy figures. Where the worked examples report 'small gap' or 'no edge survives', preserve that honest framing instead of overclaiming.

Naive shuffled k-fold is the failure mode this library exists to prevent, not a baseline to compete with on accuracy. The fair comparison between CV schemes is the label-overlap fraction they admit, not their reported score.

Prefer the documented public API: WalkForwardSplit, PurgedKFold, PurgedGroupKFold, CombinatorialPurgedCV, reconstruct_paths, deflated_sharpe_ratio, probabilistic_sharpe_ratio, min_track_record_length, and the diagnostics module.
